review.imagery: Thirteen distinct project renders were visually reviewed. Seven original assets come from Wasl’s current project gallery. Six additional native images come from its Rapid Deals hosted branded brochure, with Village streets and arrival identified as district context. One split-image living-room resource was excluded in favour of the complete official gallery view. Card and hero use the four-bedroom frontage. No card badges.
review.floorPlans: The three main layouts use the official factsheet. The additional corner roof sheet comes from a Rapid Deals hosted Wasl copy. Its printed 3,882.90 sq ft conflicts with the main 4,659.16 sq ft figure. Do not add these totals. The 3 BR plot minimum also differs between source summary and drawing. Confirm the approved contractual areas and included features with Wasl. Official factsheet physical pages 13, 16 and 19 were visually reviewed in full. Roof physical page 7 and its number panel were reviewed separately. Whole sheets retain branding and unit-position keys. The corner pool and lift remain layout-specific. Overlapping broker main layouts are excluded from duplicate choices.
review.location: Official factsheet page 27 and the current primary project guide were reviewed. The two published car estimates retain their source scope. Both official Pinewood and Ashwood embeds publish 25°01'13.6"N 55°10'40.4"E, transcribed to 25.020444, 55.177889 and explicitly scoped as their shared JGE vicinity reference. Both page hashes, the DMS reference and arithmetic are saved. No numbered-ring unit or particular home entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Original primary factsheet and earlier variant, broker brochure and plan PDFs, source hashes and retrieval receipts remain cached. Gallery source URLs, dimensions and hashes are saved. The published roof and plot-area conflicts are retained, with no amendment to the completed text research.

unavailable: A verified home-specific visitor-entrance coordinate and dated construction photographs were not established. The published corner roof and 3 BR plot-area conflicts require developer confirmation.
